limitations: The phrase 'reasonable or proper' remains unresolved; these requirements supply physical evidence without selecting a legal threshold, interpretation or compliance label.

The source atom drv.sight_distance_adequate and its surrogate description introduce a judgment classification. This extraction conflict is retained explicitly; only underlying physical sight distance is requested here, without silently changing the source.
The supplied residue is preserved in the exact note. Its reference to surrogate rules and model bounds does not authorize selecting an operationalization, model, bound or decision pattern.
Observed actions and circumstances do not establish interior mental states, intent or what the actor actually perceived.
Actual stopping distance is unavailable without a recorded stopping event and documented measurement endpoints. Missing stopping observations must remain missing.
Modeled stopping distance is derived evidence whose applicability depends on documented assumptions and inputs; it does not establish an observed stopping outcome.
Physical sight distance depends on viewing geometry, target characteristics, occlusion and measurement method; it does not establish adequacy or actual perception.
Traffic queue annotations depend on their extraction conventions. Underlying participant positions and motion must remain available without adopting an annotation as a legal rule.
Authored roadway and weather facts must remain distinguishable from measured physical observations, and factual lookups remain sourced world_setup inputs.
No simulator capabilities or external coverage landmarks were verified from the supplied inputs. The landmarks list is empty, and recording availability is not asserted.
Sampling, occlusion, synchronization and measurement uncertainty can limit reconstruction of contemporaneous conditions; these requirements do not support every imaginable later predicate.
No existing observable_requirements were supplied for this matched phrase and note.

Source capability limitation is prospectively addressed by native setup-probe-v4 and per-episode source-bound RGB contrast calibration; this remains finite target-specific sampled environmental range, never exact meteorological cutoff or geometric sight distance.
No modeled stopping distance is supplied; optional model channel explicitly records null. No legal speed/adequacy label.
